title: Characterization of a position code
statement: Let $s$ be a natural number, let $z$ be an integer with $|z|\le s$, and let $j\in\{0,1,\ldots,2s\}$. The position code of $z$ with bound $s$ equals $j$ if and only if $z=j-s$.
